messages:
sarah: Quick planning thread  proposing a focused ISV integration track: LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters should work with our Gateway with minimal changes. Idea: publish an "adapter-bridge" shim + cert badge + marketplace tile. Who volunteers for tests, docs, and marketing?

diego: I'll take tests. Proposal: run a compatibility matrix across 3 models (open-llama, ggml-7b, redwood-compat) x short+long seq x streaming/non-streaming. Need sample prompt sets from runtime.

leo: Technical note: shim = simple proxy normalizer. Map adapter calls to our /v1/generate and emulate stream frames. Low-risk feature-flag rollout. I'll draft a minimal shim example for adapter authors.

olivia: Marketing: target public co-announce in 3 weeks. Need partner-approved copy and logos 7 days before. Can we also record a 60s demo?

kim: Docs/devex: I'll produce a 3-step quickstart (curl, python sdk, migration note) + a GIF diagram. Please drop any sample prompts in this thread.

dev-bot: CI: feature/shim branch smoke tests started (run 512). Will post results.

sarah: Action list: diego tests (due in 5d), leo shim PR (3d), kim docs (6d), olivia assets/timeline (7d). Check-in Fri 11am PT.
